seo.title: Kings Plumbing & Heating – Plumbers & Heating Engineers in Maidenhead
seo.description: Family-run plumbing, heating and bathrooms in Maidenhead since 1979. Boilers, central heating, bathroom refurbishments and power flushing. Gas Safe registered.

hero.lead: A family-run business with qualified, experienced plumbers, ready for anything from emergencies to efficient central heating systems and bespoke bathroom installations.

services.intro: We are equipped to deal with a vast range of plumbing and heating work, and we pride ourselves on our professionalism, reliability and expertise.

items.title: Boiler installation
items.text: Efficient boilers, with the system designed to fit neatly into your home. We look at the whole system, not just the boiler.
items.image_alt: Plumber working on pipework in a wall

items.title: Bathrooms & wet rooms
items.text: Bathroom design and refurbishment, with tile samples and computer aided designs so your final decision is the right one.
items.image_alt: Modern bathroom with double vanity and walk-in shower

items.title: Servicing & repairs
items.text: Boiler servicing, boiler repairs and gas safety checks.

items.title: Central heating & radiators
items.text: Radiators and central heating systems, plus power flushing.

items.title: Hot water & water softeners
items.text: Unvented cylinders and water softeners installed and maintained.

items.title: Emergency plumbing
items.text: No call out charge, and we make sure we are there when you call.

reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: Russ designed, project managed and fitted a lovely bathroom that replaced a very dated and bodged 90s suite. It looks so incredibly nice… It's clear Russ is very knowledgeable and has high standards, so I have no hesitation in recommending this company.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Kings completely removed my ancient and failing central heating system and installed a new one. Everything now works perfectly. Russell, who did most of the work, was unfailingly pleasant and left everything tidy. I would recommend Kings.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Since 2013 when Mike & Russell replaced our central heating system, we have been fortunate to be able to call on them for all our heating and plumbing needs… They are completely reliable and their work is first class!
items.label: Which? review

quote.intro: Three quick steps and we’ll get back to you.

faqs.a: Yes. Kings Plumbing & Heating is a Which? Trusted Trader, and you can read all our customer reviews on our Which? page.

faqs.q: Do you charge a call out fee?
faqs.a: No. There’s no call out charge.

faqs.q: How do you keep disruption down on a bathroom job?
faqs.a: We keep dust down to a minimum, make sure you have the facilities you need each evening, and clean and tidy up each night.

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: Use the quote form on this page or call 01628 337477. A few photos of the job help us give you an accurate price.
